method: Each pdf_filenm_announcemt of the tracked auctions snapshot (3828 records, 3828 files) was fetched from https://www.treasurydirect.gov/instit/annceresult/press/preanre/<year>/<file> and read with pdftotext -layout for the line 'Embargoed Until <time>' (parse_release), or 'For Immediate Release' when no time is stated. Classes: bills and cash management bills by security_type = Bill and cash_management_bill_cmb, notes and bonds otherwise. weekdays_to_settlement counts Monday to Friday days after announcemt_date up to issue_date, with no holiday table. Where the PDF on file is an amended announcement dated after announcemt_date (A_20220517_*, A_20230316_*, A_20250415_*), the time read is the amendment's, not the original's.
script: scripts/announcement_release_times_1301.py (fetch needs the network and pdftotext; check and summarise need neither)
status: evidence. Read from Treasury's own announcement files; no declaration, record or figure reads this file, and metadata/settlement_announcement_dating.json, metadata/net_settlement.json and metadata/sources_measurement.json are not edited by it.
